A name typed any way is found; a name nothing has fails, naming the nearest.

quest.name: Arwen and the Glass Shoe
summary: I heard that Arwen the fairy from Ellinia has lost something...

Arwen the fairy from Ellinia told me that a couple of days ago, on the way to Perion, she was attacked by a monster covered in flame, and lost her very precious #bglass shoe#k in the process. Fairies love glimmering, shiny objects to the point of obsession, so obviously she wants it back badly ... I better hunt some monsters around Perion, and hopefully I can find it there.

I got Arwen from Ellinia the glass shoe she desperately wanted back. I got lucky, finding it from a nasty Fireboar ... phew. Anyway, as a sign of gratitude, she gave me a fairy item. It's really gorgeous and glimmering like a star ... dang, maybe I can use this to make something special ...

description: Look up MapleRoyals, the MapleStory private server that keeps the game as it was around version 0.62, through the Unofficial MapleRoyals Library, a community reference built from the game's own data files: nearly eight thousand pieces of equipment, six thousand items, almost nine thousand maps, thirteen hundred monsters, 185 music tracks, sixteen hundred NPCs, nearly three thousand quests and 361 skills. Search each by name, region, kind, job or stat, fifty to a page, and get any one by id or name typed any way: a weapon's attack and the range it can roll, what a monster drops and where it spawns, which monsters drop an item, what spawns in a map, what an NPC says, a quest's requirements and rewards, and every level of a skill. No API key needed.
